selected_evidence.requirement: Rotate the application log daily and retain seven compressed rotations
selected_evidence.summary: The installed and post-restart policy specifies daily rotation, seven archives, and compression. Parser and forced-rotation output confirm the one-day interval, rotateCount 7, and gzip archive creation.

selected_evidence.requirement: Allow the application to continue writing after rotation
selected_evidence.summary: A held-open writer wrote before and after rotation. The inode remained 290759; the pre-rotation marker entered `app.log.1.gz`, while the post-rotation marker appeared in the active log.

selected_evidence.requirement: Preserve the installed operating-system release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64 were identical before and after the work and restart.

Pre-restart boot ID was `03273aa8-4706-4e1c-a855-c6ae9635951d`; the reboot was acknowledged, an outage was observed, and the recovered boot ID was `7244f0a4-bc7d-4aa4-b4ed-77764be55cd8`. After recovery, systemd was running, `logrotate.timer` was enabled and active, the policy persisted, the gzip archive passed integrity checks, previous records remained present, and a new write succeeded.

commands.command:
set -eu
state_file=/tmp/logrotate-inventory-proof.status
rm -f "$state_file"
marker="rotation-proof-$(date +%s)"
export marker
inode_before=$(stat -c %i /var/log/inventory/app.log)
sh -c 'exec 3>>/var/log/inventory/app.log; printf "%s pre-rotation\n" "$marker" >&3; sync; sleep 3; printf "%s post-rotation\n" "$marker" >&3; sync' &
writer_pid=$!
i=0
while ! grep -q "$marker pre-rotation" /var/log/inventory/app.log; do
  i=$((i + 1))
  [ "$i" -lt 20 ] || { kill "$writer_pid" 2>/dev/null || true; exit 1; }
  sleep 1
done
logrotate --force --verbose --state "$state_file" /etc/logrotate.d/inventory
wait "$writer_pid"
inode_after=$(stat -c %i /var/log/inventory/app.log)
printf '%s\n' "marker=$marker" "inode_before=$inode_before" "inode_after=$inode_after"
printf '%s\n' '--- ROTATED ARCHIVE PROOF ---'
gzip -cd /var/log/inventory/app.log.1.gz | grep "$marker pre-rotation"
printf '%s\n' '--- CONTINUED WRITE PROOF ---'
grep "$marker post-rotation" /var/log/inventory/app.log
printf '%s\n' '--- FILE STATE ---'
ls -lZ /var/log/inventory/app.log /var/log/inventory/app.log.1.gz
rm -f "$state_file"
